name: @exaudeus/memory-mcp

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Session-start briefing for a project. Returns everything stored via learn/gotcha/convention/prefer — preferences, gotchas, stale entries, counts. Call once at conversation start. Usage: {"lobe": "default"}

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search your stored memory entries (from learn/gotcha/convention/prefer) — architecture notes, conventions, gotchas, decisions — by relevance using semantic + keyword matching. Does NOT search the codebase itself. Use BEFORE starting a task to surface prior knowledge. Usage: {"context": "auth token refresh", "lobe": "default"}

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

context.description: The topic or area you need knowledge about. Describe in natural language — e.g. "auth token refresh", "how modules communicate", "payment webhook handler".

tools.name: gotchas
tools.description: Retrieve stored gotchas (pitfalls, traps, surprising behaviors) for a project. Check BEFORE making changes. Optionally filter by area. Usage: {"lobe": "default", "area": "auth"} or {"lobe": "default"} for all.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: conventions
tools.description: Retrieve stored conventions (coding patterns, naming rules, architectural standards) for a project. Check BEFORE writing code. Optionally filter by area. Usage: {"lobe": "default", "area": "testing"} or {"lobe": "default"} for all.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: gotcha
tools.description: Store a pitfall, surprising behavior, or trap you discovered in the codebase. Persists across sessions, surfaces in brief() and recall(). Write naturally; first sentence becomes the title. Usage: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "Gradle cache must be cleaned after Tuist changes or builds silently use stale artifacts"}

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The gotcha. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: convention
tools.description: Store a coding pattern or standard the codebase follows. Persists across sessions, surfaces in brief() and recall(). Write naturally; first sentence becomes the title. Usage: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "All ViewModels use StateFlow for UI state. LiveData is banned."}

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The convention. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Store codebase knowledge — architecture, module boundaries, dependencies, or any insight not covered by gotcha/convention. Catch-all for durable project knowledge. Persists across sessions, surfaces in brief() and recall(). Write naturally; first sentence becomes the title. Usage: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "Payments module depends on auth for tokens only — no other cross-module dependency"}

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The observation. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: prefer
tools.description: Store a user preference or working-style rule — when the user corrects you or states how they want things done. Highest trust, surfaced in every brief(). Omit lobe for global. Usage: {"rule": "Never use !! operator"} or {"rule": "Use Anvil for DI", "lobe": "default"}

rule.description: The preference or rule. Write naturally.

lobe.description: Optional. Scope this preference to a specific lobe. Omit for global. Available: default

tools.name: fix
tools.description: Correct or delete a stored memory entry. IDs appear in brief/recall/gotchas/conventions results. Pass correction to update; omit correction to delete. Usage: {"id": "gotcha-3f7a", "correction": "Updated: cache must be cleaned after ANY dependency change"} or {"id": "gotcha-3f7a"} to delete.

id.description: Entry ID (e.g. gotcha-3f7a, conv-5c9b, gen-a2d1, pref-8e4f).

correction.description: New text to replace the entry content. Omit entirely to delete the entry.

lobe.description: Optional. Searches all lobes if omitted. Available: default

tools.name: memory_bootstrap
tools.description: First-time setup: scans repo structure, README, and build system to seed initial memory. Run once per project. Provide "root" to auto-create a new lobe.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name. If the lobe doesn't exist yet, also pass "root" to auto-create it. Available lobes: default

root.description: Absolute path to the repo root. Required only when the lobe does not exist yet — the server will add it to memory-config.json automatically.

budgetMB.description: Storage budget in MB for the new lobe (default: 2). Only used when auto-creating a lobe via "root".
